Change c0457. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. XXIII.

Context before (unchanged): A grin was on the face of the monster; he seemed to jeer, as with his fiendish finger he pointed towards the corpse of my wife.

1818 text: I rushed towards the window, and drawing a pistol from my bosom, shot; but he eluded me, leaped from his station, and, running with the swiftness of lightning, plunged into the lake.

1831 text: I rushed towards the window, and drawing a pistol from my bosom, fired; but he eluded me, leaped from his station, and, running with the swiftness of lightning, plunged into the lake.

Diff: I rushed towards the window, and drawing a pistol from my bosom, [-shot-] {+fired+} ; but he eluded me, leaped from his station, and, running with the swiftness of lightning, plunged into the lake.

Context after (unchanged): The report of the pistol brought a crowd into the room.

result.rationale: Replaces 'shot' with 'fired' ("drawing a pistol from my bosom, [-shot-] {+fired+}"); the action and outcome are unchanged, so this is a verb swap that keeps the meaning.
